content.short: Zeta Markets is a Solana-based decentralized derivatives exchange for liquid futures and options.
content.description: Zeta Markets is a Solana-based, decentralized derivatives trading protocol. It provides liquid, non-custodial, and under-collateralized trading, letting users participate in derivatives without handing control of their assets to a central intermediary. Through its decentralized exchange (DEX), traders can place fast, responsive orders and bet on the future prices of crypto assets. By design, Zeta brings traditional-market tools—such as forex and stocks-style strategies—into the blockchain environment, broadening access to advanced derivatives for decentralized finance participants.
